definitions.gloss: written calculation; long-form arithmetic done on paper
definitions.explanation: The method of performing arithmetic calculations by writing numbers down on paper, as opposed to mental arithmetic or using a calculator. A fundamental skill taught in elementary school.

examples.japanese: {筆算|ひっさん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}する→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧。
⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{筆算|ひっさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}った→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: I learned how to do written calculations in elementary school.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暗算|あんざん}→暗算：15852_anzan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{筆算|ひっさん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦やろう→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
examples.english: This problem is too hard to do in my head, so let's work it out on paper.

notes:
Composed of {筆|ひつ} (writing brush, pen) + {算|さん} (calculation). Refers to the standard method of writing out calculations vertically on paper.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {筆算|ひっさん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}する→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧: to calculate on paper
- {筆算|ひっさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧: how to do written calculations
- ⟦{掛|か}け{算|ざん}→掛け算：05334_kakezan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{筆算|ひっさん}: long multiplication
- ⟦{割|わ}り{算|ざん}→割り算：05335_warizan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{筆算|ひっさん}: long division

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{暗算|あんざん}→暗算：15852_anzan⟧: mental arithmetic — calculating in one's head without writing anything down
- そろばん: abacus — calculating with an abacus; a traditional Japanese skill
- ⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧: calculation — the general term for any form of calculation

USAGE:
{筆算|ひっさん} is a core part of Japanese elementary math education. Students learn to perform addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division using the vertical written format. The term is most commonly heard in educational contexts.
